prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Future Companion", "Select a pet to preview how they play, react, and rest on your desktop.", "Choose Companion"]
1: ["Your Pet is Awakening", "We are preparing your pet's personality and desktop home."]
2: ["Already have a pet? Sign into your existing account to restore your saved companion.", "Sign in to keep your pets synced across devices."]
3: ["Custom Pet Photo Assistant", "Upload clear, well-lit photos for accurate pet generation.", "Clear facial lighting", "No blurry motion", "Select Photos"]
4: ["Generating Desktop Pet...", "Your pet will appear on your desktop tray once generation completes."]
5: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Right-click your pet anytime to bring up controls, feed them, or change desktop settings.", "Start Interacting"]
6: ["Choose How to Create Your Pet", "Pick an instant companion ready to play, or generate a custom pet from your own photos."]
7: ["A New Companion Awaits On Your Desktop", "Every desktop pet brings life, warmth, and fun to your daily workflow.", "Begin Journey"]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your desktop pet is officially registered.", "Certified Companion", "Name Your Pet"]
9: ["Ready for Action!", "Your pet is now active in your taskbar and desktop background."]
